title: Activist shot after accusing Nkomazi officials of sabotaging village water in Schoemansdal, South Africa
description: An unidentified gunman shoots and injures a community activist outside his home in Schoemansdal, South Africa. The victim had recently used social media to accuse Nkomazi Local Municipality officials of sabotaging water provisions in a number of villages.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SAF22095

title: Activists cut off water supply in protest over tourism industry consumption amid drought in Barcelona, Spain
description: Activists in Barcelona demand restrictions are placed on the tourism industry's water consumption in light of the severe drought in Cataluna. They occupy the Turisme de Barcelona Consortium, shutting off the water supply.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. ESP16523

title: Airstrike targets drinking water facility in El Babliye, Lebanon
description: Israeli forces carry out an airstrike on a building used for drinking water in El Babliye, Lebanon. Casualties are unknown.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN28924

title: Airstrikes kill 10 and damage water infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine
description: Russian forces launch airstrikes on Zaporizhzhia, southeast Ukraine, damaging water and power infrastructure, a cancer treatment center and over 40 private buildings. 10 civilians are killed and 42 are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. UKR192723

title: Al Shabaab ambush destroys water truck and kills two in Lamu West, Kenya.
description: Al Shabaab militants ambush a military convoy between Wito and Hindi, Lamu West, Kenya, destroying a military vehicle and a water truck. The group claims two soldiers were killed.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. KEN14097

title: Al Shabaab blows up water borehole in Buulo Xaaji, Somalia
description: Al Shabaab attaches a magnetic explosive device to a water borehole in Buulo Xaaji, Somalia. The borehole is destroyed in the blast.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SOM47126

title: Al Shabaab explosive device destroys water truck in Lower Shabelle, Somalia
description: An improvised explosive device planted by Al Shabaab destroys a water truck in a convoy from the African Union Transition Mission and Uganda Peoples' Defence Forces in Lower Shabelle, Somalia.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SOM43455

title: Al Shabab blows up water truck and claims three soldiers killed in Lower Shabelle, Somalia
description: Al Shabaab detonates a remote-controlled explosive device, targeting Uganda Peoples' Defence Forces (UPDF) and African Union Transition Mission in Somalia (ATMIS) troops in Lower Shabelle, Somalia, as they pass between two villages. A water truck is destroyed and Al Shabaab claims to have killed three soldiers.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SOM43669

title: Al-Qaeda militants claim to have targeted UAE water tanker in Abyan, Yemen
description: Al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula (AQAP) militants claim to have targeted a water tanker belonging to "United Arab Emirates (UAE) mercenaries" in Abyan, Yemen.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. YEM92490

title: Armed clans clash over river water; one killed, six wounded in Yirol, South Sudan
description: Two clans armed with wooden sticks and spears clash over river water at a cattle camp in Nyinloou, Yirol, South Sudan. One person is killed and six people are left with stab wounds.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SSD9743

title: Armed clash over children washing at water tank leaves six injured in Agra, India
description: Members of the Valmiki and Prajapati communities clash in Agra, India, after Valmiki children are assaulted for washing their hands and feet at a water tank. Stones, axes, and firearms are used, leaving six injured, including one with bullet wounds. A shop is set on fire and arrests follow.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND156522

title: Armed dispute over village water tank construction leaves six injured in Pachladi, India
description: Two groups clash over alleged encroachment of land as a result of the construction of a water tank for public use in the village of Pachladi, India. Sticks, bricks and rods are used in the dispute, leaving six people injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND150715

title: Armed group abducts water tanker driver in threat over water deliveries in Manipur, India
description: Around 15 suspected armed Kuki assailants abduct a Muslim water tanker driver near Moreh town in Manipur, India, after he delivers water to Indian Reserve Battalion (IRB) police forces. The driver is released later the same day with a warning not to supply them with water again.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND149680

title: Armed youth abduct children at water point in Akobo, South Sudan
description: Suspected Murle youth abduct two children from the Lou Nuer community at a water collection site in Akobo, South Sudan. Local youth pursue the abductors, but further details are unknown.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SSD13425

title: At least 15 injured in clash over land irrigation system in Bogra, Bangladesh
description: Two groups of villagers clash with batons and rods in Aolakandi village in Bogra, Bangladesh, during a dispute over the local irrigation system. At least 15 people are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BGD26887

title: At least 30 injured in BNP factional clash over water body in Kishoreganj, Bangladesh
description: Rival Bangladesh National Party (BNP) groups clash in Kishoreganj, Bangladesh, over control of a local water body, injuring at least 30 people.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BGD28895

title: At least five injured as BNP factions clash over control of canal in Bashila village, Bangladesh
description: A violent clash breaks out between two factions of the Bangladesh National Party (BNP) in a dispute over the control of a canal in the Rajshahi village of Bashila, Bangladesh. The groups are armed with sticks and improvised weapons, leaving at least five people injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BGD29760

title: At least nine killed as Rapid Support Forces attack civilians and burn water stations in Azraq, Sudan
description: Rapid Support Forces (RSF) attacks civilians in the village of Azraq, Sudan, because they did follow an RSF order to vacate the village. Between nine and 15 civilians are killed, and water and electricity stations are set on fire.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SUD30857

title: At least two killed in clash at watering point in Anole, Kenya
description: Suspected Wardei and Wailwana community members clash with weapons at a watering point in the village of Anole, Kenya, amid a land dispute. At least two people are killed and two are left injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. KEN16012

title: Attack on the Golo water reservoir in North Darfur
description: On May 26, the paramitary group Rapid Support Forces (RSF) attack and occupy the Golo water reservoir, in El Fasher, North Darfur, a critical resource for an estimated 270,000 people, but the army and allied groups retake it the next day.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Sudan Tribune 2024

title: Attacks on energy systems in Sumy, Ukraine cut water supplies
description: Attacks on energy systems in Sumy, Ukraine cut water supplies.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; ANTIKOR 2024c ; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. UKR174316

title: BLA militants destroy water supply machinery near a military camp in Balochistan, Pakistan
description: Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA) militants open fire near a military camp in Zamuran Tehsil in Balochistan, Pakistan. They destroy machinery and solar systems used for water supply.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK143579

title: BLF ambush in Kech District, Pakistan, targets military vehicles, including water tanker
description: Balochistan Liberation Front (BLF) militants ambush four military vehicles, including a water tanker, in Kech District, Pakistan. The BLF claims five soldiers were killed and several injured. Vehicles sustain heavy damage.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK142028

title: BLF attacks military checkpoint and water supply in Kech, Pakistan
description: Armed Balochistan Liberation Front (BLF) militants attack checkpoints in Kech, Pakistan, targeting the military's water supply.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK146694

title: BNP and UP members attacked and thrown into reservoir over irrigation project in Pich Kamtal, Bangladesh; seven injured
description: Members of the Bangladesh National Party (BNP) and United People's Bangladesh (UP) are attacked by around 15 armed locals who claim they are obstructing an irrigation project in the Pich Kamtal area of Bandar Upazila, Bangladesh. Two BNP members are thrown into a reservoir and later rescued by the police. In total, seven people are injured in the attack. One victim files a case for attempted murder.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BGD29562 ; Prothomalo 2024

title: Bahrain's Jaw Prison inmates protest over living conditions; prison cuts off drinking water in response
description: Detainees of Jaw Prison, Bahrain, protest to demand improved living conditions. Prison officials cut off drinking water to the protesters.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BHR12613

title: Bangladesh National Party leaders stab Jubo Dal leader in dispute over canal control in Companiganj, Bangladesh
description: Local Bangladesh National Party (BNP) leaders fatally stab a Jubo Dal leader and injure three others during a fight over control of a canal in Companiganj, Bangladesh.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BGD29339

title: Boko Haram and ISWAP clash in Mafa, Nigeria; 16 dead and eight water vessels seized
description: Boko Haram and Islamic State – West Africa Province (ISWAP) fighters clash in the rural town of Mafa, in Borno State, Nigeria. Boko Haram kills 16 ISWAP members and seizes eight water vessels, as well as weapons and cash.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. NIG38060, NIG37525

title: Booby-trapped water tower kills three civilians in Inakarot, Mali
description: An improvised explosive device planted on a water tower generator detonates in Inakarot, Mali, killing three civilians and injuring one.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MLI33191

title: Brothers killed by landmine while deepening water well in Wadi Al Nile, Yemen
description: Two brothers are killed when a suspected Houthi landmine explodes while they are deepening a water well in Wadi Al Nile, Yemen.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. YEM90252

title: Canal dispute sparks deadly clash between Sylhet villages in Bangladesh, killing one and injuring 70
description: Residents of the villages of Rafinagar and Mirzapur clash in Derai, Bangladesh, over control of a government canal. One person is killed and at least 70 are injured. Shops in Banglabazar are also looted and vandalized.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BGD28624

title: Cantonment Board councilor fatally shot in Karachi, Pakistan; attack possibly linked to water supply dispute
description: Unidentified gunmen on a motorcycle shoot dead an elected Cantonment Board councilor and injure his brother in a targeted attack in Karachi, Pakistan. The killing is thought to be related to a personal enmity or action he took against people disrupting water supply in his area.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK143132

title: Castilla residents clash with authorities over removal of sewage water pump in Piura, Peru
description: Residents of the 28 de Julio settlement in Castilla, Piura, Peru, clash with local police and administrators who attempt to remove a water pump. Locals say the pump is needed to clear sewage flooding after a system collapse.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PER9862

title: Child killed in grenade blast near irrigation official's house in Sibi, Pakistan
description: Militants throw a grenade near the home of the Sibi Irrigation Department's sub-divisional officer in Balochistan, Pakistan, killing a child and wounding three others.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK145436

title: Chinese dam workers are attacked and killed in Pakistan
description: Five Chinese nationals working on the Dasu hydroelectric dam site are killed along with their driver on March 26 when a suicide bomber targeted their vehicle in northwest Pakistan.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; The Hindu 2024

title: Chinese hacking campaign gains access to major water, energy, and telecomm systems, including in US
description: An ongoing Chinese hacking campaign known as Volt Typhoon successfully gains access to numerous US-based companies in telecommunications, energy, water, and other critical sectors, with 23 pipeline operators targeted.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Bing 2024 ; Phillis and Daly 2024

title: Civilian and police reservist killed in clash at water point in Nakwamoru, Kenya
description: Unknown gunmen shoot and kill a civilian during a raid at a watering point in Nakwamoru, Kenya, likely due to pastoral violence in the area. Afterwards, there is a clash between the unknown assailants and the National Police Reservists. A police reservist is killed.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. KEN13551

title: Clash over water access injures three in Najafgarhi, India
description: Members of two communities clash in Najafgarh, India, over who would fetch water first from a shared tap. Three people are seriously injured in the fight.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND159709

title: Clash over water distribution injures four in Jhando Marri, Pakistan
description: Two groups from the Kachhi community clash with sticks in Jhando Marri, Pakistan, during a dispute over water distribution. Four people are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK142006

title: Clash over water extraction rights leaves one dead, three injured in Dadu District, Pakistan
description: An armed clash breaks out between Bhurt community groups over water extraction rights in Kothi Khokar village in Dadu District, Pakistan. One person is killed and three others are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK146229

title: Clashes among different refugee groups over access to drinking water kill three in a refugee camp in Kakuma, Kenya
description: Refugees from South Sudan clashed with refugees from Africa's Great Lakes region, mainly Congolese, Burundians, and Rwandans at the Kakuma refugee camp in Kakuma, Kenya, over drinking water resources. The clash results in the death of three South Sudanese refugees.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. KEN13705

title: Clashes between farmers and Rapid Reaction Force over water shortages leave one dead, six injured in Kut, Iraq
description: Farmers protesting water shortages in Kut, Iraq, clash with Rapid Reaction Force, leaving one dead and six others injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IRQ61358

title: Clashes between regime members and QSD forces damage water station near Deir ez-Zor, Syria
description: Armed clashes between regime forces and Syrian Democratic Forces (QSD) in rural Deir ez-Zor, Syria, damage a water station. Casualties unknown.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SYR124922

title: Councilor severely injured by landmine while repairing water supply in El Plateado, Colombia
description: A local councilor from the Liberal Party is gravely injured by a landmine in El Plateado, Colombia. The device, allegedly planted by the Carlos Patino Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) dissidents, explodes while he attempts to connect water for residents. The victim loses a leg to amputation after the explosion.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. COL27191

title: Cyclists attacked in Saintes, France, en route to anti-megabasin rally
description: Five assailants attack a group of cyclists on a farm in Saintes, Charente-Maritime, France, on their way to protest against megabasins in the "Water Village" in Melle. The attackers assault one demonstrator and throw themselves on a tent with a 68 year old woman inside. They also steal bikes and puncture car tires. Victims say they were attacked due to differences in ideology.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. FRA34746

title: Dalit man assaulted for drinking water at pump near temple in Bhadohi, India
description: A young Dalit man is assaulted for drinking water at a handpump located close to a temple in Bhadohi, India. The attackers also assault him verbally with casteist slurs.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND170583

title: Deadly clash over a water source in in Nueva Esperanza Chacula, Guatemala
description: Militias from El Aguacate and Chacula hamlets clash over a disputed water intake in Nueva Esperanza Chacula, a town in Huehuetenango, Guatemala. The altercation started after members of Chacula were fixing the damaged intake, which was broken by the El Aquacate community. Three people are killed and numerous others are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. GTM8558

title: Deadly clashes are reported between Syrian regime forces and the Islamic State over control of Wadi Adiad Dam
description: Clashes take place between Syrian regime forces and IS members around Wadi Abiad Dam in eastern Homs and resulted in deaths and injuries.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SYR121983

title: Deadly fight over water supply line in Karachi, Pakistan
description: Residents and local builders clash with guns and physical violence in Karachi, Pakistan, over an illegal water supply line. One person is killed and two others injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK139507

title: Delhi water board employee assaulted in sewer drainage dispute, India
description: About 20 to 25 people, led by a member of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), are suspected of assaulting a Delhi water board employee during a dispute over sewer water drainage in the Kalyan Vihar neighborhood of North Delhi, India. The employee says he fell after being slapped and hit with a shoe, and was then beaten by men who had accompanied the AAP member.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND168605 ; The Indian Express 2024

title: Dispute over water point in Narus, South Sudan, critically injures several and displaces thousands
description: Bunno and Nyianginyang sections of the Toposa clash with stones and sticks over ownership of the Lokisele Lopua water point in Narus, South Sudan. Between nine and 11 people are critically injured, and 11,000 are displaced.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SSD9689

title: Dispute over water pump distribution leads to hospitalization in Bhadrapur, Nepal
description: During a ward meeting in Bhadrapur, Nepal, a Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist) ward member assaults the ward secretary amid arguments over allocating water pumps. The secretary is hospitalized for their injuries.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. NEP24613

title: Dispute over water sparks deadly clash between Kuchi groups in Shaykhabad, Afghanistan
description: Two armed Kuchi groups clash in Shaykhabad, Afghanistan, in a dispute over water. One person is killed and another is seriously injured after a gunman opens fire.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. AFG67912

title: Dispute over water use between fishers and farmers kills one and injures three in Maga, Cameroon
description: Fishers and rice farmers in Maga, Cameroon, fight after fishers divert water from a rice field to their channels. The clash kills one farmer and injures three fishers.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. CAO13880

title: Drone strike on village well kills five in Maqbanah, Yemen
description: A drone strike carried out by unidentified assailants strikes a village well in Maqbanah, Yemen, killing five civilians including two young girls who were fetching water at the time of the attack. Houthi and Internationally Recognized Government (IRG) forces exchange accusations over responsibility.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. YEM87246

title: Durban municipal workers vandalize water meters in salary protest, South Africa
description: Durban Solid Waste workers overturn refuse bins, abandon vehicles, and vandalize water meters in a protest demanding higher salaries.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SAF20743

title: ENDF seizes generator and water pipe, claims to have killed several in alleged OLF-OLA clashes in Oromia, Ethiopia
description: Ethiopian National Defense Force (ENDF) claims to have clashed with the Oromo Liberation Front-Oromo Liberation Army (OLF-OLA) and killed a number of militants in Gora Dola and Negele areas of Oromia, Ethiopia. They seized various items including a generator, more than 200 meters of water pipe, medicines, and identity documents.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. ETH13404, ETH13405

title: Eight explosive devices planted in Al Hudaydah water well, Yemen
description: A farmer finds a foreign object in a water well he is cleaning in Al Hudaydah, Yemen. He alerts authorities who discover eight explosive devices have been planted in the well, likely by Houthi rebels.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Yemen Daily News 2024

title: Eight villages left without water following Ukrainian drone attacks on substation in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine
description: Ukrainian forces launch drone attacks on the "Fregat" transformer substation in the occupied village of Mykhailivka in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine. The attack destroys high-voltage electrical equipment, leaving eight villages without electricity and water.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. UKR216621

title: Eleven are hospitalized after clashes between ethnic Tajiks in Afghanistan and the Taliban over the Qosh Tepa Canal project
description: On July 7, 2024, 11 people are reportedly hospitalized after protests against the Qost Tepa Canal project. The clash took place between ethnic Tajiks in Afghanistan and Taliban leaders near the Qosh Tepa Canal.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Goble 2024

title: Environmental and water rights activist kidnapped in Villa Madero, Mexico
description: Unidentified assailants abduct an environmental activist from El Zangarro community in Villa Madero, Mexico. The activist is known for defending forests and water access in an area dominated by avocado and berry orchards. He is rescued alive two days later.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MEX88846

title: Environmental leader Juan Lopez who is helping protect a river is murdered in Honduras
description: Juan Lopez, an environmental activist in Honduras who worked to protect forests and rivers is assassinated, the fourth member of his organization to be killed since 2023.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; DW 2024

title: FAMa and Wagner forces kill five civilians and destroy a water tower in Tachorft, Mali
description: FAMa (Malian Armed Forces) and Wagner forces kill five civilians and destroy a water tower in the village of Tachorft in Bourem, Mali. Corpses are booby-trapped with improvised explosives.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MLI31982

title: FAMa and Wagner group destroy water tank and abduct infants in Tuareg camps in Tessalit, Mali
description: Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and the Wagner Group (Russian private military company) raid Tuareg encampments in Tessalit, in the Kidal region of Mali. They burn tents, destroy a water tank, and abduct two infants.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MLI32632

title: FAMa and Wagner kill 11 civilians and destroy water wells in Kidal, Mali
description: Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and Wagner Group (Russian private military company) forces raid Teghayghayt and nearby Tin-Alamadja in the Kidal region of Mali. 11 civilians are killed. They arrest residents, seize livestock, loot traders, and destroy water wells and satellite equipment.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MLI32535

title: Fano claims attack on water tank at Ethiopian Defense Force camp in Amhara, Ethiopia
description: Fano (Amhara-based militia group) claims to have shelled a water tank at an Ethiopian National Defense Force (ENDF) camp in Birsheleko, in the Amhara region of Ethiopia. The group says seven soldiers were killed (figures unverified) in the attack and many wounded.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. ETH13795

title: Farmer dies by self-immolation following protest over irrigation canal dispute in Melmalayanur, India
description: A farmer in Melmalayanur, India, sets himself on fire following a protest held in solidarity with a neighboring landowner seeking to build an irrigation canal on the farmer's land, which the landowner claims is public property. Officials confirm the land belongs to the farmer’s family, but he continues to face pressure over the dispute. He is taken to hospital but later dies from his injuries. Police find a suicide note naming 23 individuals.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND168775 ; Nadu 2024

title: Farmer protests over lack of water for crops in Nalgonda, India, lead to physical altercations
description: Farmers linked to the Alimineti Madhava Reddy Project (AMRP) in Nalgonda, India, protest over lack of water for crops. The demonstration leads to physical altercations between farmers and police.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND165311

title: Farmers attacked carrying water in Mapate, Mozambique; one person beheaded
description: Islamist militants attack farmers carrying water in the village of Mapate, Mozambique. At least one farmer is beheaded. Islamic State (IS) claims responsibility for the attack.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MZM4405

title: Farmers break dike of water company to irrigate crops amid water shortages in Piura, Peru
description: Farmers protesting water shortages in Piura, Peru, break the dike of a local water company in order to irrigate their crops. They clash with police but there are no casualties.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PER10816

title: Farmers clash at protest over water pipeline damage in Junin, Peru
description: Around 200 locals and farmers in Junin, Peru, protest against a private company that damaged a pipeline and left the surrounding areas without water for their crops. They block roads, set fire to tires and clash with one another. There are no fatalities.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PER9677

title: Farmers clash with police over canal access in Sullana, Peru
description: More than 60 farmers in Sullana, Peru, clash with police at a canal while trying to collect water for their crops during a water shortage. Police fire shots in the air to disperse them.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PER10523

title: Farmers in Mexico sabotage illegal commercial water systems to restore flow for downstream villages
description: Farmers sabotage illegal water connections, water pumps, and unlicensed containment ponds that are taking water for large-scale avocado farms at the expense of water supply to downstream villages.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Firstpost 2024

title: Farmers protesting extreme water use by a US agribusiness in Mexico are fired upon by police, killing two
description: Two farmers protesting extreme water use and groundwater contamination caused by a Carroll Farms feed plant in Totalco, Veracruz, Mexico are killed by police during a large community protest.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Bacon 2024

title: Farmers threaten mass suicide to demand compensation for land lost to irrigation project in Bidar, India
description: Members of Karanja Horata Samiti, a farmers' organization, stage a protest in Bidar city, India, demanding compensation for land they lost to the Karanja Irrigation Project. They carry nooses and threaten mass suicide if their demands are not met. A farmer is rescued by a police officer and hospitalized after he attempts to consume poison.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND173689

title: Father and son injured during a dispute over access to water in Shivpuri, India
description: Three men assault a man and his son with rods in Shivpuri, India, during a dispute over water collection. Both victims sustain head injuries and are hospitalized.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND156527

title: Father and son shot dead following irrigation dispute in Modinagar, India
description: A father and his two sons are shot following a dispute over irrigation water in Modinagar, India. The argument began over the family’s use of water for their mango orchard. Although the dispute was reportedly resolved, the attackers later opened fire on the victims, killing the father and one son and injuring the other. The assailants then threw the bodies of the deceased into a canal before fleeing the scene.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Hindustan 2024

title: Five killed and two injured when military forces are attacked while fetching water in Myanmar
description: Forces of the Taw Bone Gyi People's Defence Force and Tanintharyi Yoma Force attack Myanmar military troops in the Tanintharyi region of Myanmar while they are fetching water. In the battle, five soldiers are killed and two injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MMR57799

title: Five killed, eight injured in clan dispute over water sources in Jalalaqsi, Somalia
description: Militias from Hawadle and Abgal clans clash between the villages of Ceelhareeri and Tarda, Hiiraan, Somalia over use of water sources and grazing pastures. Five people are killed and eight are left injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SOM47172

title: For weeks Turkish military forces attack the Tishrin Dam in Syria with reports of deaths and injuries
description: Beginning on 9 December 2024 and continuing through January 2025, pro-Turkish Syrian National Army (SNA) military forces attack the Tishrin Dam on the Euphrates in Syria, severely damaging electrical generation infrastructure and cutting power to numerous population centers. At least five civilians are killed and 15 injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Syrian Observatory for Human Rights 2024

title: Forces opposed to the Syrian government seize the main water pumping station for the city of Aleppo, cutting water supplies
description: Forces opposed to the Syrian government of Assad seize the main water pumping station for the city of Aleppo, cutting off water to the city.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Chehayeb 2024

title: Four Sudanese refugees attacked while fetching water near refugee camp in Metema woreda, Ethiopia
description: Unidentified gunmen assault four Sudanese refugees while collecting drinking water near the Awlala Akushara camp in Metema woreda, in the Amhara region of Ethiopia. The victims are seriously injured in the attack and are hospitalized for severe blood loss.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. ETH12971

title: Four injured in protest over water supply and disconnection of illegal water connections in Johannesburg, South Africa
description: Dozens of residents protest the disconnection of their illegal water connections and the lack of formal water supply in the Lenasia South area of Johannesburg, South Africa. They block roads, throw stones at the water agency workers who cut off the illegal connections and throw rocks at police. Police fire rubber bullets to disperse the crowd. Four demonstrators are injured, with one requiring hospital treatment.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SAF22354

title: Four injured in violent clash over water drainage in Haryana, India
description: Two groups clash violently in Mamauta Kalan village, Haryana, India, in a dispute over drain water. They pelt stones and bricks, leaving four people injured. Three are reported to be in serious condition.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND156153 ; Bureau 2024

title: Four killed and eight injured in clash over Indian government water distribution in Shri Hargobindpur
description: Rival groups fight with weapons in the town of Shri Hargobindpur, India, during a dispute over the distribution of government-supplied water. Four people are killed and eight injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND161897

title: Four water engineers from Khuzaa municipality in Gaza are killed by an Israeli air strike
description: Four water engineers on their way to repair water infrastructure in Khuzaa, Gaza are killed by an Israeli airstrike on their vehicle.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Oxfam 2024

title: Gang attack on water board members and local officials inspecting spring leaves six dead and three injured in Chiapas, Mexico
description: Water board members and local officials are attacked with gunfire while inspecting a spring near the town of Pantelhó, Chiapas, Mexico, leaving six dead and injuring three. The attack is carried out by the Los Herrera gang, who controlled the municipality until 2021. Residents report that the authorities had asked the Ministry of National Defense (SEDENA) to accompany them to the spring, but the request was denied.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MEX85527 ; LaJornada 2024

title: Gangs attack water and food deliveries in Haiti in power struggle
description: In Haiti, gangs, including the "G9" gang, struggle for power and attack water and food deliveries causing severe shortages among Haiti's poorest.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Buschschlüter 2024

title: Girl killed by shelling while fetching water in Khyber, Pakistan
description: Artillery fire kills a young girl in Tirah Valley in Khyber District, Pakistan, while she collects water from a well. The shelling is part of an ongoing military operation that has also damaged nearby homes.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK146681

title: Grenade attack on irrigation office wounds two in Khuzdar, Pakistan
description: Unidentified militants throw a hand grenade at the irrigation department office in Khuzdar, Pakistan, injuring two people. The attackers flee the scene.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK146206

title: Grenade thrown at home of irrigation department engineer in Turbat, Pakistan
description: Unidentified assailants (likely Baloch separatists) throw a hand grenade at the home of an executive engineer from the government irrigation department in Turbat, Pakistan.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK146512

title: Guerrilla attack on oil pipeline leads to river oil spill in Norte de Santander, Colombia
description: Members of the National Liberation Army (ELN), a Colombian guerrilla group, detonate an explosive device attached to an oil pipeline in rural Norte de Santander, Columbia, causing an oil spill into the Margua River and nearby water sources.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. COL28701

title: Gunmen kill an employee of eThekwini Municipality’s water and sanitation department in Springfield, South Africa
description: Unidentified gunmen kill an employee of eThekwini Municipality’s water and sanitation department in Springfield, Durban, South Africa
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SAF21235

title: Gunmen open fire on protest over flooding and water shortages in Chilpancingo de los Bravo, Mexico; two killed, four injured
description: Armed men open fire on people gathering outside a department store to join a protest demanding action on drinking water shortages, flooding, and poor infrastructure in Chilpancingo de los Bravo, Mexico. Two people are killed and four others are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MEX95787

title: Gunmen open fire on solar water project committee in Uzlat Yuhayr, Yemen
description: Unidentified gunmen open fire on a Rural Water Authority committee and stop them from accessing the site of a solar-powered water project in Uzlat Yuhayr, Yemen.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. YEM90912

title: Hafiz Gul Bahadur Group militants kill water tanker driver in Mir Ali, Pakistan
description: Hafiz Gul Bahadur Group (TTP-HGB) militants fatally shoot a driver delivering water to government authorities in Mir Ali, Pakistan.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK141739

title: Heavy fighting in Al Zorg, North Darfur, Sudan, leaves nearly 100 dead and water resources destroyed
description: Clashes continue between Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), backed by Darfur Joint Forces (JSAMF), and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), supported by Arab militia in Al Zorg, Kutum (North Darfur, Sudan). SAF airstrikes are reported as joint forces retake RSF bases, the airport, and weapons depots. The joint forces claim to have killed or wounded 700 RSF soldiers, while RSF denies the figure and accuses its rivals of ethnic cleansing. Joint forces are accused of killing 39 civilians, burning the hospital and market, and destroying local water resources. Fatalities are estimated at 89, including 50 RSF fighters and 39 civilians.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SUD32404

title: Homes left without water following Ukrainian strike on munitions warehouse in Kamennyi, Russia
description: Ukrainian forces conduct drone strikes on a munitions warehouse in Kamennyi village, Russia, triggering a series of explosions. In nearby Tikhoretsky District, 131 houses lose electricity and water and 1,200 people are evacuated. There are no civilian casualties.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. RUS23470

title: Houthi forces abduct 70 civilians; authorities cut off water from villages in Jiblah, Yemen
description: Houthi fighters abduct 70 civilians from two villages in Jiblah, Yemen, following the death of a Houthi leader during a clash with a family a week earlier. Houthi authorities also cut off the villages' water supply.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. YEM85564, YEM85565

title: Houthi forces arrest Oxfam aid worker during water project field visit in Sadah,Yemen
description: Houthi forces arrest an Oxfam International water and sanitation project manager during a field visit to a water project in Sadah, Yemen. The reason for the arrest is unclear, but occurs amid Houthi claims of a "CIA-linked US-Israeli spy network" crackdown. The Oxfam worker is released eight months later, in May 2025.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. YEM91814

title: Houthi shelling damages water project in Shabwah, Yemen
description: Houthi forces shell Al Atfah in the Ain district of Shabwah, Yemen, severely damaging a local water project.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. YEM86974

title: Hundreds occupy Ancipa dam in Troina, Sicily, to block supply diversion amid shortages
description: Hundreds of people, including residents and local mayors, occupy the water distribution facilities of Lake Ancipa dam in Troina, Sicily, for three days and attempt to block a pipeline supplying Caltanissetta and San Cataldo. The protest is led by the mayors of Troina, Nicosia, Sperlinga, Gagliano Castelferrato and Cerami, whose municipalities rely solely on the Ancipa reservoir for their water supply. The action is sparked by a decision of the regional water emergency control room to restore water exclusively to Caltanissetta and San Cataldo after failures were discovered in their usual well systems, leaving the five municipalities dependent on the dam at risk of severe shortages. The company managing the dam later reports the protesters to the Troina Carabinieri.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. ITA25264 ; Quotidiano 2024 ; Tondo 2024

title: IS gunmen attack water tanker in Deir ez-Zor, Syria, injuring one
description: Islamic State (IS) members armed with machine guns open fire on a water tanker belonging to the Syrian Democratic Forces (QSD) in Abu Khashab, Deir ez-Zor, Syria, injuring one.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SYR133278

title: ISIL members attack water station in rural Deir ez-Zor, Syria
description: A Syrian Democratic Forces (QSD) military point in a water station in rural Deir ez-Zor, Syria, is attacked and damaged by members of the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL).
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SYR138106

title: Independent Electoral Commission official injured during demonstration over water shortages near Kamaqhekeza, South Africa
description: Residents protest the lack of water and the poor state of roads in the village of Dludluma, near Kamaqhekeza, South Africa, assaulting and injuring an electoral commission official.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SAF20577

title: Indigenous people block highway in protest over water shortages in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil; 15 injured
description: Guarani, Guarani Kaiowa, and Terena Indigenous people block a highway between the areas of Itapora and Dourados in Matto Grosso Do Sul, Brazil, to protest water shortages. Military police fire rubber bullets and use pepper spray to disperse the protesters. 10 police vehicles are vandalized and 15 people are injured, including three Indigenous people and 12 police officers.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BRA91965

title: Internally displaced persons block roads and empty water tankers during protest in Goma, Democratic Republic of Congo
description: Internally displaced people in Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, barricade roads to protest renewed attacks on their camp and demand aid. Protesters block and empty two humanitarian water tankers en route to deliver water to the Rusayo camp. Police intervene to restore order.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. DRC33071

title: Islamic State attack damages water tanker in Deir ez-Zor, Syria
description: Islamic State (IS) militants attack a water tanker in the countryside village of Al-Hessan in Deir ez-Zor, Syria. During the attack, two Syrian Democratic Forces (QSD) members are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SYR127751

title: Islamic State fighters destroy a water tank and injure shepherd in Homs countryside, Syria
description: Islamic State (IS) fighters attack shepherds in rural Homs, Syria, destroying a water tank and killing 80 sheep. One shepherd is wounded.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SYR125288

title: Israel's military blows up more than 30 water wells in Gaza in July 2024
description: Between July 18 and 27, Israeli forces destroy more than 30 water wells in the southern Gaza towns of Rafah and Khan Younis, according the the head of water networks for the Khan Younis municipality.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Arab News: Reuters 2024

title: Israeli airstrike damages water and electricity networks in Al Nabatieh, South Lebanon
description: Israeli warplanes strike Al Nabatieh, Lebanon, targeting Hezbollah infrastructure. During the raid, water and electricity networks are damaged.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN20833

title: Israeli airstrike damages water and power networks in Aita ech Chaab, Lebanon
description: Israeli warplanes strike Aita ech Chaab, Lebanon, during ongoing clashes with Hezbollah. The strike causes damage to electricity and water networks. Israeli forces also fire machine guns toward the town.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN24046

title: Israeli airstrike damages water and power networks in Tay Harfa, Lebanon
description: Israeli warplanes strike Tayr Harfa, South Lebanon, targeting Hezbollah militants. The attack causes major damage to water and electricity networks.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN19586

title: Israeli airstrike in Hanniyeh, South Lebanon, damages utilities and injures civilians
description: Israeli warplanes carry out an airstrike on a house in Hanniyeh, Lebanon, during ongoing clashes with Hezbollah. The strike injures five civilians and damages water and electricity networks.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN22956

title: Israeli airstrike injures civilians and damages water and power networks in Wadi Jilo, Lebanon
description: Israeli warplanes strike a house in Wadi Jilo, South Lebanon, amid clashes with Hezbollah. The strike causes severe damage to water and electricity networks. Four civilians are injured, and two Civil Defense workers are hurt while extinguishing a fire. Israel claims it targeted Hezbollah infrastructure.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN21763

title: Israeli airstrike kills two Palestinian workers repairing water pipes in Gaza, Palestine
description: Israeli warplanes carry out an airstrike in Abasan al Kabirah, located in the Khan Yunis area of the Gaza Strip, Palestine. The attack kills two Palestinian workers who are repairing water pipes.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE45341

title: Israeli airstrike near Chamaa, Lebanon, damages water and electricity networks
description: Israeli warplanes carry out an airstrike in the area of Chamaa, southern Lebanon, amid ongoing clashes with Hezbollah. The attack damages water and power infrastructure.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN23518, LBN23517, LBN23519, LBN23520, LBN23516

title: Israeli airstrike on water company in Tyr, Lebanon, kills two and injures four
description: Israeli forces conduct an airstrike on the Tyr Water Company in Tyr, south Lebanon. Two people are killed, including the deputy mayor of Burj al-Chemali, and two others are injured in the attack.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN30421

title: Israeli airstrike on water tanker in Jabalya, Palestine, leaves several dead
description: Israeli warplanes strike a water tanker in Jabalya, Palestine. Three people are thought to have been killed but the exact figure is unknown.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE60987

title: Israeli airstrike targets water station in Nasriyeh, Lebanon
description: Israeli warplanes strike a water station in Nasriyeh, Lebanon, amid ongoing hostilities with Hezbollah. Casualties are unknown.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN24508

title: Israeli airstrike targets water supply point in Beit Lahiya, Palestine
description: An Israeli airstrike in Beit Lahiya, Palestine, targets a water supply point. A school is also struck, and an area outside of a hospital is shelled. At least 11 people are killed.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE61962

title: Israeli airstrike targets water tanks in Tyr, South Lebanon
description: Israeli warplanes strike water tanks in the vicinity of Yarine, South Lebanon, amid ongoing fighting with Hezbollah.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN20062

title: Israeli airstrikes leave nine dead and damage water networks in Tyr, Lebanon
description: Israeli airstrikes destroy buildings and damage water networks in Tyr, Lebanon. Nine people are killed and 12 are wounded.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN29389

title: Israeli artillery shells strike water container in Gaza Strip, Palestine
description: Israeli artillery shells strike a water container in the Musabbah area north of Rafah, Gaza Strip, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE53505

title: Israeli drone blows up water tank in Majdel Zoun, Lebanon
description: A drone launched by Israeli forces during a ceasefire explodes in a water tank in Majdel Zoun in Tyr, Lebanon.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN31411

title: Israeli drone strike damages water infrastructure in Al Wazzani, Lebanon
description: Water infrastructure is damaged during an Israeli drone attacks in Al Wazzani, Lebanon.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN18342

title: Israeli drone strike targets Palestinians collecting water, killing 13 in Gaza, Palestine
description: Israeli warplanes strike a group filling water jugs in Gaza City, Palestine, killing 13 Palestinians and injuring a number of others.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE46561

title: Israeli forces launch airstrikes across Lebanon’s Tyr District; water networks damaged, one dead, five injured
description: Israeli forces carry out airstrikes on multiple localities across Lebanon’s Tyr District, including Majdel Zoun, Rmadiyeh, El Bayada, Tayr Harfa, Jannata, Jouaiya and Maarakeh. The strikes damage water networks and other infrastructure, as well as property and crops. In Jouaiya, one person is killed and five others are injured. Casualties elsewhere are unknown.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN28442, LBN28444 , LBN28449, LBN28450, LBN28455, LBN28456, LBN28454

title: Israeli forces open fire on people filling water outside hospital, killing two in Beit Lahiya, Palestine
description: Two people are killed and others are injured when Israeli forces open fire on people gathering to collect water at the Kamal Odwan Hospital in Beit Lahiya in Gaza, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE64047

title: Israeli forces open fire on water tanks during clash with Palestinian militant groups in Jenin, Palestine
description: Israeli forces raid Jenin camp in West Bank, Palestine, and exchange fire with Palestinian militant groups, including Hamas, Al Aqsa Martyrs Brigade, Mujahideen Brigades, and Katibat Jenin (PIJ). Israeli soldiers target homes and open fire on water tanks, and an Israeli drone strikes gunmen hurling explosives. Two Palestinians are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE59167

title: Israeli gunfire aimed at El Meri farmers in Levanon leaves water tanks and bee hives badly damaged
description: Israeli forces fire machine guns at farmers in El Meri, Lebanon, causing extensive damage to the town's water tanks and bee hives.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN19690, LBN19688

title: Israeli jets destroy a water distribution vehicle in the Nuseirat Refugee Camp, Gaza, killing one
description: An Israeli air strike against a water distribution vehicle kills at least one Palestinian and wounds six others in the Nuseirat Refugee Camp in Gaza, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Azzoum 2024 ; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE59783

title: Israeli settler and military forces raid Qusra, Palestine, damaging Palestinian homes and water tanks and injuring two
description: Around 20 Israeli settlers, accompanied by Israeli forces, raid Qusra in West Bank, Palestine, throwing stones at Palestinian houses. 18 windows and a solar panel are destroyed, along with eight water tanks and a gate. Palestinians repel the attack, and both settlers and soldiers fire live rounds. Two Palestinians and one settler are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE52104

title: Israeli settler damages pipeline supplying water to more than 30 homes in Hebron, Palestine
description: An Israeli settler damages a pipeline supplying water to more than 30 homes in Hebron, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE55342

title: Israeli settlers assault and run over Palestinian at a water spring in Jericho, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers attack and run over a Palestinian with an all-terrain vehicle at a water spring in Jericho, West Bank, Palestine. The victim is hospitalized for their injuries.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE56928

title: Israeli settlers assault deputy mayor and Palestinian workers installing water pipelines in Hebron, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers attack Palestinian municipality workers and the Bani Naim deputy mayor in Hebron, Palestine, while water pipelines are being installed. The deputy mayor is hospitalized.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE54092

title: Israeli settlers assault foreign journalist covering attacks on water well in Jericho, Palestine
description: A foreign journalist covering settler attacks on a water well to prevent its use by Palestinians is beaten by Israeli settlers in Jericho, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE58397

title: Israeli settlers assault herders and block access to spring in Tubas, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers assault Palestinian cow herders and prevent them from accessing a spring in the city of Tubas, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE56916

title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians installing water pipelines in Umm Safa, Palestine, injuring three
description: Israeli settlers open fire on Palestinians and beat workers installing water pipelines in Umm Safa in West Bank, Palestine, leaving three people injured. Israeli forces then raid the area to secure settlers before firing tear gas at Palestinians, causing several people to suffer inhalation injuries.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE64542

title: Israeli settlers attack farmers and spill drinking water in Khirbat Zanutah, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers attack Palestinian farmers, spill their drinking water and force them out of Khirbat Zanutah in Hebron, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE60320

title: Israeli settlers attack water pipelines supplying Palestinian farms in Ayn al Bayda, West Bank
description: Israeli settlers attack and destroy water pipelines used by Palestinian farmers in Ayn al Bayda, West Bank.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE61939, PSE61793

title: Israeli settlers cut water pipes and harass Bedouin families in Tubas, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers in Ain As Sakout in West Bank, Palestine, harass Bedouin families, cutting water pipes, blocking roads and throwing stones, driving the Palestinian families from the area.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE52660

title: Israeli settlers damage Palestinian crops and pollute water well in Hebron, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers contaminate a water well and destroy Palestinian crops in Hebron, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE45842

title: Israeli settlers damage water pipelines in Massafer Yuta, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers from the Suseya settlement damage water pipelines on Palestinian land in Massafer Yuta, West Bank, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE63057

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian agricultural water pumps near Tubas, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers damage water pumps for agricultural pools on Palestinian-owned land in Khirbat ad Dayr, near Tubas, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE52031

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian crops and irrigation systems in Nahhalin, Palestine
description: Dozens of Israeli settlers destroy irrigation systems and uproot olive trees and other crops on Palestinian lands in Nahhalin, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE58889

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian farmer's water pumps in Khirbat ad Dayr, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers damage water pumps belonging to a Palestinian farmer in Khirbat ad Dayr in West Bank, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE51819

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian farmland and irrigation system in Hebron, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian-owned farmland and its irrigation system in Hebron, Palestine, and remove the surrounding fence.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE58381

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian water meters during mass raid on Kifil Haris, Palestine
description: Thousands of Israeli settlers raid Kifil Haris, Palestine, to perform prayers in disputed shrines. They throw stones at Palestinian houses, destroy several water meters and attempt to set fire to a vehicle.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE56421

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian water meters during raid in Salfit, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers raid the village of Kifil Haris, Salfit, West Bank. They destroy water meters and throw stones at Palestinian houses.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE62001

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian water meters in Kifil Haris, Palestine
description: Israeli settler rioters destroy several water meters belonging to Palestinians during a raid on Kifil Haris, Palestine, to perform Jewish prayers in the area.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE46921

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian water pipeline and crops in Bethlehem, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers destroy a Palestinian-owned water pipeline and crops in Al Jabah in Bethlehem, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE48695

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian water pipelines in Ayn Samiya, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers damage and destroy Palestinian-owned water pipelines in Ayn Samiya, West Bank, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE54213

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian water well and block roads in Salfit, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers destroy a Palestinian-owned water well and agricultural walls in Salfit, Palestine. They also block roads used by farm vehicles.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE53270, PSE53276

title: Israeli settlers destroy water container, olive trees and agricultural structures on Palestinian land in Bayt Imrin, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers on Palestinian-owned land destroy a water container, stone walls, olive trees and agricultural structures in Bayt Imrin, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE59668

title: Israeli settlers destroy water pipeline on Palestinian land in Nahhalin, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers attack Palestinian land in Nahhalin in West Bank< Palestine. They destroy a water pipeline and chop down olive trees and grape vines.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE64445

title: Israeli settlers destroy water pipelines in Hebron, Palestine
description: Israeli settler rioters destroy water pipelines and grape vine seedlings in Hebron, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE46851

title: Israeli settlers destroy water pipelines near As Sawahira ash Sharqiya, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers destroy water pipelines that serve Bedouin communities near the town of As Sawahira ash Sharqiya, West Bank, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE61752

title: Israeli settlers destroy water tank in Rujayb, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers destroy a water tank and trees on Palestinian land in Rujayb, West Bank, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE60981

title: Israeli settlers destroy water tanks in Hebron, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers destroy water tanks on Palestinian-owned land in the Umm Sarara area of Hebron, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE62460

title: Israeli settlers destroy water valves that supply villages in West Bank, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers damage main water valves in Sabastiyah, West Bank, which supply nearby Palestinian villages.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE55746

title: Israeli settlers destroy water well in Ayn al Bayda, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers set fire to a Palestinian-owned residential building and destroy a water well in Ayn al Bayda in West Bank, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE64906

title: Israeli settlers destroy water well on Palestinian land in Yasuf, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers destroy a water well and cut down 15 olive trees on Palestinian-owned land in Yasuf, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE64975

title: Israeli settlers drain water well in Salfit, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers empty a water well and destroy fencing and metal structures on Palestinian-owned land in Salfit, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE55730

title: Israeli settlers in military uniforms vandalize water tanks, assault Palestinians, and loot livestock in West Bank, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers disguised in military uniforms attack Palestinians east of Siir in West Bank, Palestine. They vandalize water tanks, injure residents, loot 300 sheep, and destroy residential rooms.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE59270

title: Israeli settlers in the West Bank block off the al-Auja spring, preventing Palestinians from accessing the water
description: Israeli settlers in the West Bank block off the al-Auja spring, preventing Palestinians from accessing the water.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Lonsdorf 2024

title: Israeli settlers puncture Palestinian-owned water containers in Hebron, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers in Hebron, Palestine, puncture Palestinian-owned water containers, dismantle a tent and cut down 20 olive trees.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE46365

title: Israeli settlers torch Palestinian water tank in West Bank, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers riot and set fire to a Palestinian-owned water tank in Ramallah and Al Bireh, West Bank, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE54715

title: Israeli settlers vandalize Palestinian water systems in in Massafer Yuta, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers raid Yuta in Hebron, Palestine. They cut water pipes and destroy tanks in Massafer Yuta on Palestinian-owned land.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE59666

title: Israeli settlers violently block Palestinians from water well in Khirbat Tana, Palestine
description: Israeli settlers, backed by Israeli forces, attack Palestinians in Khirbat Tana, Nablus, to prevent them from accessing a water well.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE59851

title: Israeli snipers kill eight Palestinians collecting water near Naser Hospital, Gaza, Palestine
description: Israeli snipers kill eight Palestinians filling water containers near Naser Hospital in Gaza, Palestine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE60063

title: Israeli soldiers are videoed destroying a major water tank in Gaza
description: Israeli soldiers are videoed wiring explosives to pumps at the Canada Water reservoir in Rafah, southern Gaza, followed by an explosion. The reservoir held 3 million liters of water and was central to the treatment and distribution of water in the Rafah area.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Stockwell and Haq 2024

title: Israeli strike kills eight at water filling station in Rafah, Palestine
description: An Israeli drone strikes Palestinians at a water filling station in Rafah, Palestine, killing eight and injuring others.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PSE60939

title: Israeli strike on café in Ras al Naqoura, Lebanon, kills four and destroys water and electricity networks
description: An Israeli airstrike hits a café in Ras al Naqoura, South Lebanon. The attack destroys water and electricity networks in the town and kills four people, including an Amal movement member and a health worker.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. LBN19768

title: Istanbul café owner dies after being stabbed and shot during dispute over leaking drain, Türkiye
description: A dispute over a leaking drain between two business owners in Istanbul, Türkiye, escalates into violence, leaving one person dead. The victim, a café owner, had confronted the owner of a neighbouring business about the leak. During the altercation, the café owner is stabbed and shot, sustaining fatal injuries.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; NTV News Center 2024

title: JNIM militants attack women and damage water pump in Gorgadji, Burkina Faso
description: JNIM (Salafi-jihadist group) militants attack and injure four women and damage a water pump at a borehole in Gorgadji, Burkina Faso.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BFO11715

title: JNIM militants destroy water well near livestock market in Kantchari, Burkina Faso
description: JNIM (Salafi-jihadist group) militants detonate explosives at a water well near a livestock market in Kantchari, Burkina Faso. The well is destroyed.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. BFO12111

title: JWS forces take control of Babiri water station following QSD clashes in rural Aleppo, Syria
description: Syrian National Army (JWS) fighters enter the town of Babiri in rural Aleppo, Syria, and take control of its water station following clashes with Syrian Democratic Forces (QSD).
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SYR137151

title: Journalists investigating reports of contaminated water assaulted at water treatment company in Udayapur, Nepal
description: Two journalists investigating reports of contaminated water at a water treatment company in Udayapur, Nepal, are assaulted by a group while collecting samples. The group is led by the company's owner.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. NEP24944

title: Karnataka politicians protest Hemavathi River “Express Canal” diversion project and clash with police in Tumakuru, India
description: Members of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP), and the Janata Dal (Secular, or the People's Party (JD(S)), including a former minister and Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLA), protest in front of the Home Minister’s residence in Gollahalli, India, in opposition of the Hemavathi river “Express Canal” diversion project. Police disperse demonstrators with baton charges, causing minor injuries and arrests, including of legislators. Indian National Congress (INC) members hold a counter-protest at the site.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND159195

title: Kuki assailants bomb water supply quarters in Jiribam, India
description: Kuki assailants detonate an improvised explosive device in Jatrapur village in Jiribam, India, destroying recently built quarters of a water supply scheme. The attack occurs amid ongoing violence between Meitei and tribal communities, including Kuki-Zomi groups.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND174316

title: Kyrgyzstan-Tajikistan Final Border Treaty
description: Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan officially resolve all outstanding border and water-sharing disputes with a landmark treaty signed in Bishkek, demarcating the full 972 km shared border including the previously disputed Vorukh exclave and Isfara River water distribution arrangements.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Joint Intergovernmental Protocol on Border Delimitation and Isfara Water Infrastructure Sharing, Batken (2024).

title: Landmine kills water tanker driver near Khanaser, Syria
description: A civilian driving a water tanker in rural Aleppo, Syria, is killed when a landmine planted by unidentified gunmen explodes.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SYR134834

title: Locals expel QSD forces after attempted theft from water stations in Aleppo, Syria
description: Residents take control of Hayet village in Aleppo, Syria, after expelling Syrian Democratic Forces (QSD) who had attempted to steal equipment from local water and electricity stations.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. SYR137600

title: Locals injured by grenade blast during protest over contaminated water in Ah Htet Hpa Re, Myanmar
description: The Kachin Independence Army attacks villagers protesting water contamination from rare earth mineral mining in the village of Ah Htet Hpa Re, Myanmar. Two people are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MMR58440

title: Malian Air Force drone strike hits water barrels in Talhandak village, Mali
description: Malian Air Force drone strikes targeting an unidentified armed group hit water barrels in Talhandak, Mali.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MLI33553

title: Malian airstrike reportedly hits water truck near Abeibara, Mali
description: The Malian Air Force conducts an airstrike northeast of Abeibara, Mali. Local sources say a water truck is hit.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MLI33112

title: Malian drone strike hits civilian vehicle carrying water tank in Kidal, Mali
description: The Malian Air Force conducts a drone strike on a civilian vehicle carrying a water tank in the village of In Tebezas in Kidal, Mali. The vehicle is left slightly damaged and there are no casualties. JNIM (Salafi-jihadist group) condemns the attack.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MLI33268

title: Malian soldiers kill pastoralist and livestock near Segou irrigation canals
description: Soldiers taking exams in Kolongo Tomo, Mali, open fire on pastoralists and cattle near irrigation canals. One pastoralist is killed and livestock is slaughtered.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MLI32923

title: Man attacks and kills aunt with axe during water dispute in Pathari, India
description: A man attacks his aunt with an axe during an argument over water in the village of Pathari, India. He fatally injures her in the neck and flees the scene.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Amar Ujala 2024

title: Man injured by landmine while turning on village water supply in Tedim, Myanmar
description: A man steps on a landmine near Tedim hospital in Chin state, Myanmar, while attempting to turn on the residential drinking water supply. He loses his right leg. Locals suspect the mine may have been planted by Myanmar military forces.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MMR66105

title: Man killed in Chitrakoot, India, in dispute over fetching water
description: Three men, reportedly linked to the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), assault and kill a man in the village of Lauri, in Chitrakoot, India. The victim, believed to be Dalit, is attacked and killed after failing to fetch water quickly. The assailants also shout casteist insults.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND159702

title: Man stabbed to death after dispute over water point in Bura, Kenya
description: Unidentified attackers fatally stab a man in Bura, Kenya, following a suspected dispute over control of a local water source.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. KEN15092

title: Maphou Dam in India is mined with explosive devices
description: The Indian Army finds three improvised explosive devices (IEDs) near Maphou Dam, Imphal East district, India. The bombs are defused.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Bordloi 2024

title: Mass protest over irrigation water access and power outages injures 15 in Babil, Iraq
description: Around 1,500 residents rally on the Baghdad–Basrah highway in Babil, Iraq, to protest the cutting off of irrigation water to farmland, power outages, and the drying up of rivers. Security forces arrest about 20 people and injure 15 while dispersing the demonstration.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IRQ56474

title: Massive Russian air attack disrupts water and energy provision in Kyiv, Ukraine
description: Power and water supplies are disrupted in parts of Kyiv, Ukraine after a massive Russian air attack in August.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; The Guardian 2024

title: Militant killed in firefight after water dispute in Kathua district, India
description: Militants infiltrating from across the border open fire at civilians who denied them water and clash with police in Kathua district, India. One militant is killed.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IND159596

title: Military shelling injures villager in Myingyan Township, Myanmar, after attack on water distiller
description: Myanmar military soldiers fire artillery into Kan Chaw village, Myingyan Township of Myanmar after an earlier attack on a military training school water distiller. One civilian is injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. MMR66091, MMR66090

title: Missile debris damages water supply pipeline in Chernivtsi, Ukraine
description: Debris from intercepted Russian missiles damages a water supply pipeline and an administrative building in Chernivtsi, Ukraine.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. UKR203722

title: Missile strikes and falling debris damage water pipes in Belgorod, Russia; six civilians injured
description: Ukrainian missile strikes and falling debris from intercepted missiles damage water pipes and power lines in Belgorod, Russia. Six civilians are injured.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. RUS23640

title: Mob accosts man who stole water jerricans in Muranga South, Kenya
description: Residents of a village near Kenol in Muranga South, Kenya, accost a man for stealing a blanket and six water jerricans and hand him to police.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. KEN15927

title: Mob stones a man to death who is accused of stealing a school water tank in Nairobi, Kenya
description: A mob in the Riruta area of Nairobi, Kenya, stones a man to death for allegedly attempting to steal a school water tank.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. KEN13723

title: Mob torches two water tankers after pedestrian killed by vehicle in Karachi, Pakistan
description: Demonstrators in the Gulshan Town area of Karachi, Pakistan, throw stones at two water tankers and set them alight after a youth is run over and killed by a vehicle.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. PAK145567

title: Mortar shell damages water pipes in Duhok, Iraq
description: A mortar shell of unknown origin hits a road in Duhok, Iraq, damaging water pipes supplying surrounding areas.
source: Pacific Institute Water Conflict Chronology; Raleigh et al. 2010 ID. IRQ61693
